items.label: Executive Desk
items.value: Experience farmhouse charm meets executive utility. This standing desk with file cabinet can be arranged in an L-shaped and offers more spacious workspace. The 55 inch desktop and 40 inch cabinet can maximize the productivity, suitable for multiple monitors, laptops, printer and other office equipment

items.label: Electric Height Adjustment
items.value: The height adjustable standing desk allows you to choose the usage height from 28.4" to 47.2". The 3 preset height adjustment button allows you to custom comfortable height for working or studying

items.label: Multifunctional Workstation
items.value: The filing cabinet equipped with a lockable wooden drawer and smooth-rolling casters, allowing for strategic placement and easily move the cabinet anywhere you need it—next to your desk or in a corner—for ultimate layout flexibility. There are hooks for hanging headphones or bag

items.label: Reliable & Durable
items.value: Constructed from industrial steel, the sit stand desk has a sturdy construction and adopts a dual-beam design, making it more stable and able to support more weight

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: Our computer desk comes with detailed instruction, all parts are clearly labeled, allowing you to assemble your standing desk and cabinet effortlessly by following our clear, illustrated instructions step-by-step
